note: Adapted from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997); the alate is marked Unknown in the original, hence no such section; the maximum head width and body length of the minor soldier appear in the original OCR as 1.95-2.1S and 6.S-S.0, and the upper limits are not recorded; synonymy, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldiers dimorphic: major soldier body length 10.80–12.70 mm, mandibles stout and falcate, length 2.16–2.34 mm, slightly less than half the head length; minor soldier body length 6.5–8 mm, mandibles slender, length 1.45 mm, more than half the head length. Alate not described.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Major soldier: head capsule reddish brown to brown; antennae pale brown; labrum reddish brown, apex translucent; mandibles blackish; body pale brown to pale reddish brown. Head and thorax with very few hairs; abdomen and legs moderately pilose. Body length 10.80–12.70 mm. Head capsule subquadrate (length to mandibular base 4.30–4.86 mm, maximum width 3.53–3.98 mm); widest posteriorly, narrowing gradually anteriorly (maximum width/length ratio 0.781–0.82, width at mandibular base/maximum width ratio 0.626). Fontanelle minute, circular, situated slightly in front of the middle of the head and leading into a small dark brown tube directed forwards. Antennae 17-segmented; segment 3 much longer than segment 2 and than the remaining segments. Labrum nearly triangular, with a triangular translucent point (length 0.81–0.99 mm, width 0.81–0.90 mm). Mandibles strong and thick, falcate, apex distinctly incurved (length 2.16–2.34 mm), slightly less than half the head length (mandible/head length ratio 0.46–0.49). Postmentum long, subquadrate (length 3.06–3.42 mm, maximum width 0.90–0.99 mm, minimum width 0.63–0.72 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 1.20–1.45 mm, maximum width 2.30–2.70 mm); anterior margin weakly concave, posterior margin strongly concave. Mesonotum distinctly narrower than pronotum; posterolateral margins weakly to distinctly incurved, posterior margin weakly incurved. Metanotum slightly narrower than pronotum; posterolateral margins slightly incurved, posterior margin nearly straight. Minor soldier: head capsule reddish brown; antennae pale brown; thorax and abdomen paler than head. Cephalic and thoracic pilosity sparse, abdominal pilosity moderate. Body length 6.5–8 mm. Head capsule subquadrate, sides strongly narrowed anteriorly (length to mandibular base 2.20–2.60 mm, width at mandibular base 1.10 mm; width at mandibular base/maximum width ratio 0.60). Fontanelle minute, circular, at the middle of the head. Antennae 17-segmented; segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2, segment 4 slightly shorter than segment 3. Labrum triangular and ligulate, with a triangular translucent point. Mandibles slender (length 1.45 mm), more than half the head length (mandible/head length ratio 0.60). Postmentum subquadrate (length 1.6 mm, maximum width 0.55 mm, minimum width 0.45 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin weakly concave, posterior margin distinctly concave (length 0.80–1.05 mm, width 1.35–1.60 mm).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Major worker: head reddish brown; antennae pale brown; postclypeus yellowish brown; dorsal body brown, paler than head; legs and ventral surface cream. Cephalic pilosity sparse, body pilosity somewhat greater. Body length 5.0–6.0 mm. Head capsule subcircular, widest near the antennae (length to mandibular base 1.60–1.75 mm, maximum width 1.90–1.95 mm). Fontanellar plate small, nearly transversely oval, translucent, length 0.13 mm. Antennae 17-segmented; segment 3 slightly shorter than segment 2; segment 4 longer than segments 2 and 3; segment 5 shortest. Postclypeus inflated, with one or two pairs of hairs anteriorly and one or two hairs medially; length less than half its width (length 0.35 mm, width 0.90–0.95 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior lobe semicircular, anterior margin weakly notched; posterior margin distinctly concave; lateral margins angular (length 0.60 mm, width 1.0–1.05 mm). Mesonotum narrower than pronotum, lateral margins slightly angular, posterior margin weakly concave. Metanotum slightly wider than pronotum, posterior margin not concave, lateral margins slightly angular. Minor worker: smaller and paler than the major worker. Body length 4.0–5.8 mm, head length to mandibular base 1.0 mm, maximum head width 1.30 mm, postclypeus length 0.25 mm and width 0.65 mm, pronotum length 0.55 mm and width 0.80 mm. Antennae 17-segmented, segments 3 and 5 nearly equal in length and shorter than the remaining segments.
